✕ Step 1 of 8
Doughnuts
Preheat oven to 350 °F.
Doughnuts
Whisk 2 c all-purpose flour, 2 tsp pumpkin pie spice, 2 tsp baking powder, and 1 tsp kosher salt in a bowl.
Doughnuts
Beat 1 can (15 oz) pumpkin puree, 1 1/2 c sugar, 1/3 c vegetable oil, 4 tbsp unsalted butter, melted, 1 tsp vanilla extract, and 3 lg eggs in a bowl until smooth.
Doughnuts
Add flour mixture to the pumpkin mixture and beat until combined.
Doughnuts
Fill doughnut pants with batter until almost full. Smooth tops with moistened finger.
Doughnuts
Bake doughnuts about 15 minutes. Check with toothpick.
💡 Tip

Gluten-free batter may need 2-3 extra minutes. Look for golden edges and a clean toothpick. — jared

Topping
Stir 3/4 c sugar and 2 tsp ground cinnamon in bowl. Brush doughnuts with 3 tbsp unsalted butter, melted and dip in cinnamon sugar.
Serve warm or room temperature.
